  Evidence of absence: The map in `scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2158-2160` contains only `tests/test_ci_job_split_contract.py`. `tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py` (478 lines, exists on HEAD) is a guard test that reads `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`CI_WF = REPO_ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "ci.yml"`, `tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:41`), `mark-stable.yml`, and `test-and-mark-stable.yml` (`RELEASE_WORKFLOWS = {"mark-stable": ..., "test-and-mark-stable": ...}`, `tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:49-52`). It is run as a script by all three workflows (`ci.yml:1591`, `mark-stable.yml:329`, `test-and-mark-stable.yml:4797`, each via `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py`). The generic test-subject resolver in `heal_scope_test_subjects` (`scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2143-2146`) maps the stem `ci_poll_test_sharding` to `scripts/ci_poll_test_sharding.sh`, `scripts/ci_poll_test_sharding.py`, `.github/workflows/ci_poll_test_sharding.yml`, and `.github/workflows/ci-poll-test-sharding.yml` — none of which exist — so a failing `test_ci_poll_test_sharding` in `mark-stable.yml` or `test-and-mark-stable.yml` produces a frozen heal scope with no entry for the workflow the test covers, leaving only `tests/**` and `changelog.d/*.md`, where the guard cannot be fixed. The LAST RUN DIFF removed `tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py` from the map because no such file existed, but did not add the real, missing entry.
